lead: Everything you need to write about TesserClip: the icon, screenshots, a fact sheet and how to reach us.

descriptions.short: TesserClip opens straight to the text you last copied, in a plain‑text editor, so you can fix it before you paste it.
descriptions.long: Copy some text, open TesserClip, and it’s already there, ready to edit. Each window is its own draft, rich text becomes plain text, and Copy All (⇧⌘C) puts the whole window back on the clipboard. TesserClip asks before closing a window with uncopied edits, and your text never leaves your Mac. It’s made for text copied from a browser, a terminal or an AI agent that needs fixing before it goes anywhere else.

iconGuidelines: Use the provided app icon files without modification.
Don’t change the icon’s colours, add effects or distort it.
Leave enough clear space around the icon.

name.title: The name
name.text: TesserClip is tesser + clip. A tesseract is a four‑dimensional cube, drawn as a cube inside a cube. The key art builds one from the glass sheets of the app icon, with the clipboard in the middle.
